origin: live, small n, real models; packets are synthetic (apprentices) with scripted blocks; the check is the same in every arm
what_is_measured: the share of model replies that pass the number-provenance check (schema, every number traces, names, no URL or instruction, no causal or expert claim); not the quality of the English

template.note: the deterministic template passes its own check on every packet and intent (see templates in the evaluation): it is the shipped wording

reword_final.mode: reword: the model rewrites a code-written draft that carries {field.path} placeholders; code fills them in, then the same check runs
reword_final.note: re-run after the hedge handling and the consequence wording were fixed. Of the 6 rejections, 3 were unknown_habit false positives of a cue rule (a clause such as 'the analysis suggests that ... is linked to'); that rule was fixed afterwards and this run was not repeated. One was a changed noun ('houses' for 'households'), one a reword that dropped a fact, one a wrong rounding.

examples_rejected.sentence: In the sandbox households, a wrong answer came out 10% of the time when the reconcile step was left out (between 8% and 13%); when it was wrong, the mean error was £292 a month (n = 200 houses).
The analysis suggests that a slower pace on shared steps is linked to 1 minute 44 seconds and a missed check to 46 seconds.
The alignment suggests that a missed check is associated with 74 seconds and a slower pace on shared steps with 54 seconds.
The alignment suggests that a slower pace on shared steps is linked to 2 minutes 7 seconds and copying a wrong figure is linked to 54 seconds.

reword_n30_before_fix.note: the first n = 30 run, before the hedge handling and the consequence sentence were fixed: 16 of 18 rejected replies were one causal_claim sentence ('led to' written for 'ended in', and the honest hedge 'not proof that one thing caused the other' flagged by the check), 3 unknown_habit

reword_first_run.note: before the prompt and the hedge handling were tightened; causal_claim and unknown_habit were the failures

free_composition_with_placeholders.note: the model writes the whole reply from the packet; it misused placeholders and wrote causal and advice sentences

free_composition_first_prompt.note: no placeholders: the model typed the numbers itself

cloud.path: egress.send, purpose evidence.explain, method check (the agent service's fast tier); privacy layer on; one ledger line per call
cloud.design: the model composes from the packet with {field.path} placeholders; it cannot be shown the code-written draft because a draft is text and the privacy layer admits none

openai_fast.note: 8 earlier calls on two older prompt versions (placeholders garbled by the port's sanitiser, plural paths) also failed and are not counted here; failures: swapped_attribution 11, unknown_habit, rank_claim_false, bad_placeholder

gemini_fast.note: the two failures were unknown_habit on 'lost time' phrasing and one swapped_attribution

cloud.cost_note: estimate at assumed prices from the model meter, not an invoice
